outcome_detail: Agent reproduced shape morphing animation (12 rounded rects in 4x3 grid, row-based circle-to-squircle morphing) with mean SSIM 0.9357, pHash similarity 0.9167, and perfect duration match. Cubic SSIM gating compressed the score to 0.4446.
strategy: Frame extraction, programmatic shape analysis, iterative parameter tuning of Revideo Rect animations
agent_behavior: Extracted all 481 frames from reference video and analyzed shapes using PIL/numpy/scipy connected components to identify 12 colored rounded rectangles in a 4x3 grid
Discovered the animation pattern: row 0 morphs circle→squircle→expanded→back over 2s phases, row 1 same pattern at 2x slower pace, row 2 static
Used ASCII art rendering and per-pixel color comparison to validate output against reference iteratively
Performed 6 render-compare-adjust cycles, progressively tuning colors (from muted to brighter to match YUV encoding), peak sizes (85→80→82), corner radii (10→5), and per-column size differences
Consulted Revideo documentation for Rect radius property and signal-based animation patterns
Final output achieved mean pixel diff of ~2.6/255 per channel, with remaining error concentrated at animation peak frames due to imperfect size/radius parameter fitting
Completed in 26 minutes using 62 episodes at $3.83 cost, marking task complete after diminishing returns on parameter tuning
